config.purpose: Validate a graph-free device-event batch timing fallback for the previously failing large FP16 GEMM. It is diagnostic only and excluded from frozen P5 v2/P6-v3.
rules: No MUSAGraph capture or replay is used.
Each sample records MUSA events around 100 ordinary kernel launches, synchronizes, then divides elapsed device time by 100.
A timing value is diagnostic only; a later P5.2 protocol must separately approve any calibration use.

parameter_status: diagnostic only; no P5/P6 model input
